visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of product or category cards, each linking to a detail page or product documents

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: optional image | optional eyebrow (product type) paragraph + heading + description + one or more CTA links. For Link Columns, put two link lists in the body (or two body cells) to show them side by side

reuseGuidance: Use for product, category or action cards that send visitors to another page. For articles use cards-article; for tools and partner tiles use cards-tool.
